verdict.rationale: Bevy is free, open-source software under MIT or Apache 2.0 with no contracts or license fees. It is consumed as a normal Rust dependency that runs entirely on the user's own machines, so there is no vendor-hosted service to depend on. A runtime probe confirms the crate resolves on crates.io with the MIT OR Apache-2.0 license, and community comments corroborate the no-strings licensing. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation framing deployment or ownership as 'self-hosting'; the capability is implied by the library model rather than documented as a feature.
